page: Microsoft Azure M416s_10_v3 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance engineered for hyper-scale in-memory computing workloads. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization and utilizing the x86_64 architecture with Intel processors, the instance delivers 416 dedicated virtual CPUs. System memory totals 9,496 GB, yielding an extensive memory-to-core allocation of approximately 22.83 GB per vCPU. Discrete GPU hardware is omitted from this configuration.

The instance features no integrated local ephemeral storage, requiring workloads to attach remote storage volumes, with native support for Premium Storage tiers. The absence of local disk drives emphasizes external data tiering, shifting I/O operational dependencies to remote storage infrastructure. Given the scale of 416 dedicated execution threads and nearly 9.5 TB of volatile memory, resource contention is minimized through dedicated CPU core allocation.

From a cost efficiency perspective, M416s_10_v3 concentrates massive memory capacity and processing scale into a single virtual server. This consolidated architecture provides an alternative to multi-node distributed clusters, eliminating inter-node network synchronization overhead for datasets that fit entirely within volatile memory. The platform is targeted at enterprise deployments, such as large-scale SAP HANA environments, extensive in-memory relational databases, and heavy data analytics pipelines.
description: The Microsoft Azure M416s_10_v3 is a dedicated, memory-optimized virtual machine tailored for extreme in-memory enterprise workloads. Powered by Intel x86_64 processors managed under Microsoft Hyper-V, the configuration provides 416 dedicated vCPUs and 9,496 GB of system RAM, yielding a high ratio of approximately 22.83 GB of memory per virtual processor. The instance contains no onboard local storage, depending entirely on external remote storage systems with support for Premium Storage tiers, and contains no hardware GPU accelerators. By aggregating nearly 9.5 TB of memory within a single compute boundary, the instance eliminates the architectural complexity and latency overhead inherent to distributed clustering. These hardware dimensions make the M416s_10_v3 well-suited for mission-critical deployments including ultra-large SAP HANA installations, massive in-memory transactional and analytical databases, and heavy real-time data processing engines requiring vast volatile memory capacity.
